subject: Post-demo: admin change-history exportability, SOC 2 / HIPAA evidence and next steps
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Keller <tom.keller@healthlink.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: admin change-history exportability, SOC 2 / HIPAA evidence and next steps

Tom — thanks for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call on admin activity and audit exports.

Key takeaways from Redwood side:
- We can provide admin change-history (who changed what, old/new values) for console actions and API keys.
- Exports: available as NDJSON/CSV via a one-time export job to customer S3, with optional gzip compression.
- Immutability options: we support WORM-style delivery (write-once S3 prefix + signed export manifest) and S3 object-level immutability when customers enable their own bucket policies.
- SOC 2 evidence: we have a summary package plus timestamps/sha256 manifests for each export to tie file contents to delivery.

Requests from HealthLink today:
1) Confirm HIPAA retention patterns (7 years vs. customer policy) and whether per-request filtering by org-id is supported.
2) See a sample export payload (field names and event types) for admin-change events and API request logs.
3) Clarify SLA for export turnaround (we discussed 4 hours for ad-hoc export; want confirm).

Attachments: sample schema + small export snippet attached for quick inspection.

Proposed next steps:
- I will share the sample NDJSON export and schema (attached).
- If you want, we can run a one-off export into a HealthLink test S3 bucket this week — need temp write creds.
- Marissa (CS lead) will follow up on procurement/security evidence flow for SOC 2 paperwork.

Can you confirm which of the above you want prioritized and whether the test S3 bucket is available?

Thanks,
Logan
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

[attachment: redwood-admin-history-schema.csv (text/csv)]
[attachment: export-sample-ndjson.gz (application/gzip)]
From: Tom Keller <tom.keller@healthlink.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Li <emma.li@healthlink.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: admin change-history exportability, SOC 2 / HIPAA evidence and next steps

Thanks Logan — great demo. A few clarifications from our security team for prioritization:

1) HIPAA retention: HealthLink's baseline for PHI-related admin traces is 6 years (state law dependent), but procurement will want the ability to request longer exports. We don't need Redwood to change retention policies server-side — just need ad-hoc exports scoped by org and timeframe.

2) Sample payload: the NDJSON looks promising; could you include the following fields (if available) in the export sample: event_id, timestamp_utc, actor_email, actor_service, target_resource, old_value_hash, new_value_hash, change_summary, request_id, correlation_id.

3) Immutability: security@healthlink.com flagged that WORM delivery + signed manifest is acceptable only if we can independently verify payload SHA256 after transfer. Can you confirm Redwood provides the manifest with SHA256 and that the manifest is signed with a Redwood key we can validate?

4) SLA: 4 hours for ad-hoc export is fine for PoC; production SLA will be part of procurement conversation.

We can provide a test bucket. I'll send temporary limited write creds to security@healthlink.com in a separate email.

Tom Keller
Director, Security Engineering — HealthLink
tom.keller@healthlink.com
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Keller <tom.keller@healthlink.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T18:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: admin change-history exportability, SOC 2 / HIPAA evidence and next steps

Tom — appreciate the clear asks. Quick responses inline and actions below.

Inline answers:
- Retention: agreed — we will not change server-side retention. Exports are ad-hoc and can be scoped by org-id and arbitrary timeframe. You can request multi-year ranges.
- Fields: attached a revised sample with the fields you listed; we've added request_id and correlation_id. Field names in CSV/NDJSON match the schema header (see redwood-admin-history-schema.csv).
- Manifest & signing: Redwood will generate a per-export manifest that includes filename, sha256, record_count, export_start_ts, export_end_ts. Manifests are signed with our export signing key (we'll provide the public key and a key fingerprint). You can verify SHA256 after S3 upload.
- SLA: We'll confirm during procurement, but for PoC we commit to target 4 hours from request to delivery for exports <= 50GB.

Actions we will take this week:
1) Marissa will send you the SOC 2 summary package and the export-playbook doc (drive link included below).
2) We can run a one-off export into the test bucket once we receive the temporary write creds. Please send them to security@healthlink.com and cc marissa.cole@redwood.ai.
3) Dev task: Karthik will create a small export job that demonstrates manifest signing and include verification steps we can run together.

See attached sample export (export-sample-ndjson.gz) and the schema. Let us know times you have for a 30-minute joint verification next week (we prefer Tue/Wed mornings PT).

Thanks —
Logan

[attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: HealthLink procurement path + checklist (for Logan)

Quick internal note — copying the actions from the call so procurement has what it needs: 

1) Deliverables to HealthLink security: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (attached in reply), export-playbook link, export sample, and public signing key.
2) PoC: schedule the one-off export into HealthLink test bucket (Logan owns scheduling; Karthik owns the export job). Target window: Tue 2027-04-20 09:00-12:00 PT.
3) Evidence for procurement: log retention statement, SOC 2 Type II report (where allowed), data flow/diagram for admin logs, and our incident response contact. Marissa will open a HubSpot checklist and attach links to the Drive folder in the deal.
4) Follow-ups: confirm export size estimate after a dry-run; note any filters HealthLink requests that increase runtime (e.g., 10-year range with correlation_id crosswalk).

I'll create the HubSpot checklist and drop the drive link in the deal record (HL-2024-072). Logan, please confirm the Tue morning window and update the related_links list once the HubSpot task is created.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Director, Redwood Inference
